import XCTest

let outDir = "/private/var/folders/vl/g_dyzwvs4_52rz0rdks_3j900000gp/T/bench-tmp-rvv9dqtl/opencode/uitest"

final class DriverTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSendReply() throws {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        sleep(2)
        let composer = app.textViews["GrowingTextView"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(composer.waitForExistence(timeout: 5))
        composer.tap()
        composer.typeText("sounds good")
        sleep(1)
        let send = app.buttons["SendButton"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(send.waitForExistence(timeout: 5))
        XCTAssertTrue(send.isHittable)
        send.tap()
        sleep(3)
        try app.debugDescription.write(toFile: outDir + "/hier_sent.txt", atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
        try XCUIScreen.main.screenshot().pngRepresentation.write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: outDir + "/sent.png"))
    }
}
EOF
